episodes.title: Welcome to Paradise
episodes.summary: At 18, Kevin Crawford finally gets a shot at joining the police force run by his dad, just as a new drug dubbed "argyle meth" hits the streets.

episodes.title: Ass on the Line
episodes.summary: Bullet finds fame and glory in an underground dogfighting ring, and Chief Crawford butts heads with his biggest rival on a maddening homicide case.

episodes.title: Black & Blue
episodes.summary: At Gina's insistence, Fitz starts carrying a gun -- and ignites a national media scandal. Shipped off to a nursing home, Hopson uncovers a conspiracy.

episodes.title: Karla
episodes.summary: When Kevin's mom buys him a sleek new talking police car, it's love at first sight. Bullet turns Dusty into a fried-chicken kingpin.

episodes.title: Dungeons & Dragnet
episodes.summary: When Preacher Paul ropes the cops into his war against a "satanic cult" of D&D players, Bullet makes a move on the preacher's virtuous daughter.

episodes.title: Meet the Jabowskis
episodes.summary: After finding a clue to her past, Gina sets out on a quest for revenge and bonds with her long-lost family -- leaving Paradise without a tough cop.

episodes.title: Police Academy
episodes.summary: While Kevin and his dad face off in the police academy Coptathalon, Bullet runs the station and Dusty helps Hopson take care of unfinished business.

episodes.title: Task Force
episodes.summary: The hunt for the argyle meth mastermind leads Kevin and his task force to the circus. A cash-strapped Dusty auctions off his virginity on the dark web.

episodes.title: Parent Trap
episodes.summary: Kevin's plan to reunite his family backfires in a big way. After seeing his DNA test results, Dusty vows to stop the town's Thanksgiving parade.

episodes.title: Christmas in Paradise
episodes.summary: As Dusty scrambles to get Paradise ready for a visit from Santa, Kevin races to root out the traitor on the force.

episodes.title: Paradise Found
episodes.summary: As tourists flock to the new, peaceful Paradise, Gina plots to bust Dusty out of prison, Kevin savors his hero status, and Karen plans an execution.

episodes.title: Big Ball Energy
episodes.summary: On Kevin Sucks Day, Fitz hunts down a new meth supplier, the chief discovers Karen's secret fetish, and Kevin vows to defy an embarrassing prediction.

episodes.title: Tucker Carlson is a Huge Dick
episodes.summary: A rant by Tucker Carlson sparks a war of the sexes, leaving Paradise with two police forces. Fitz's new evil plan is thwarted by Gal-Qaeda.

episodes.title: Who Ate Wally's Waffles
episodes.summary: Dusty finds a long-lost sitcom star living in Paradise and sets out to reboot his career. The squad obsesses over Kevin's bathroom habits.

episodes.title: The Father, the Son and the Post-it Note
episodes.summary: With crime at an all-time high, Chief Crawford decides to steal the Kingpin case back from Agent Clappers. Fitz runs into major money trouble.

episodes.title: Flip the Vote
episodes.summary: Desperate to win reelection, Karen legalizes meth — inspiring Fitz to run against her. The chief recruits Dobby for a mission. Bullet visits hell.

episodes.title: Paradise PD Meets Brickleberry
episodes.summary: Fleeing Paradise, the gang crosses over into Brickleberry National Park, just in time to help Ranger Woody and crew hunt for missing bear Malloy.

episodes.title: Operation DD
episodes.summary: After learning that Fitz isn't quite what he seems, the squad races to stop their real enemy — and save Paradise from a nuclear disaster.

episodes.title: Fallout
episodes.summary: Chief Crawford develops an unlikely, unhealthy and unholy friendship. Delbert and Robby form a new country. Fitz adjusts to married life.

episodes.title: Top Cops
episodes.summary: Paradise PD juices its arrest stats in order to win a cop contest. Fitz gets a new identity. Dusty terrorizes a father-son doughnut shop.

episodes.title: Ice Ice Babies
episodes.summary: Chief wants another kid, but he must prove to Karen that his dad skills have improved. Robby opens a carnival. Dusty turns the screws on Fitz.

episodes.title: Trigger Warning
episodes.summary: Does the town of Paradise have a gun problem? Depends on who you ask. Also, Dusty bribes Bullet to appear in his online videos.

episodes.title: Showdown at the O-bese Corral
episodes.summary: Dusty inspires a revolution at Weight Watchers. Bullet worries Gina may have an addiction. Fitz's wife lands a job at SeaWorld.

episodes.title: How the Cookie Crumbles
episodes.summary: Dusty gives Fitz a new identity: "Family Feud" host Steve Harvey. Meanwhile, Chief Crawford tries stealing his own sperm from a fertility clinic.

episodes.title: Blind Drunk
episodes.summary: Lovelorn Kevin invents an imaginary girlfriend in hopes of making Gina jealous. Chief Crawford learns the town never repealed Prohibition.

episodes.title: Blimp City
episodes.summary: Paradise PD combats the city's drone menace. Karen's mother, Agatha, moves in to help with baby prep. Kevin offers to assist Gina with her tech issues.

episodes.title: The World According to LARP
episodes.summary: Karen asks Chief to play nice with Hopson, but the task proves surprisingly humiliating. Kevin tries to get Gina into Live Action Role Playing.

episodes.title: Fetal Attraction
episodes.summary: The mutants enter stage three in their quest for revenge. Gina's family kidnaps Kevin. The Chief worries his unborn child has it in for him.

episodes.title: What Happens in Twatemala
episodes.summary: Karen bets big, hoping a new casino will raise enough money to rebuild Paradise. Kevin's relationship with Gina remains stubbornly platonic.

episodes.title: PARAD-ISIS
episodes.summary: Gina and Kevin make a big announcement, Bullet worries Fitz is on the verge of an unpleasant discovery, and Dusty joins a "gym."

episodes.title: The Brozone Lair
episodes.summary: Excited to finally have the son he always wanted, Chief Crawford focuses on being a new father while the townspeople build a utopia — inside Dobby.

episodes.title: Diddy's Home
episodes.summary: Karen replaces everyone in town with actors to impress Elon Musk, Kevin gets an inflatable girlfriend and Dusty obsesses about impressing his father.

episodes.title: A Star Is Porn
episodes.summary: Inspired by his son's interest in a kids' band, Chief Crawford decides to pursue his artistic ambition. Kevin accidentally becomes an adult film star.

episodes.title: Good Jeans
episodes.summary: A billionaire moves his company to Paradise, forcing Robby and Delbert to get jobs. Chief Crawford searches for the perfect outfit to impress Charles.

episodes.title: The Shartist
episodes.summary: When Gina returns to town, Kevin tries to prove she's a clone. Dusty becomes an art sensation and Chief Crawford falls prey to his virtual assistant.

episodes.title: The Butt Cut
episodes.summary: To undo a family curse, Chief Crawford must cater to the whim of a witch living on the outskirts of town. Kevin looks for dirt on Charles Lovely.

episodes.title: Boat!
episodes.summary: Kevin tries to sneak back into Paradise to warn his friends of Charles' evil plan while they take jobs selling Lovely Corp. products door-to-door.

episodes.title: King of the Norf
episodes.summary: The resistance plots to take down Lovely Corp. Karen mixes up her medication, causing mayhem. Chief Crawford and Fitz struggle to move Dusty's mother.

episodes.title: Sack to the Future
episodes.summary: Determined to change his life, Kevin journeys back in time to undo a childhood mistake — but meddling with the past doesn't solve his problems.

episodes.title: The Eternal Reckoning
episodes.summary: With the town suspended in the air, everyone rallies together to defeat Charles Lovely before it's too late. Dusty plans a family reunion.
